title: SCS-Quantum: A Lightweight, Zero-Dependency Verification and Measurement Engine for Superconducting Transmon Circuits
description: SCS-Quantum is an open-source, dual-layer (pure Python standard library and high-performance Rust) verification engine for transmon quantum processors. Features hardware benchmarks across 7 independent runs on the 156-qubit IBM Heron processor (ibm_marrakesh), measuring empirical Bell-state balance (median 94.9%, range 87.7%-99.3%) and multi-qubit GHZ state distributions.
